lee (AE): Harbor wants a perf POC next week. Target: sustained 900 RPS chat, avg ~5 tokens/req, p95 <= 180ms. They want: 1) runbook + heatmap, 2) reserved vs burst cost delta, 3) note on HSM in us-west1. Can we do this Mon/Wed?
marco (SE): Yes. Proposal: warmup 20m, steady 60m at 900 RPS (poisson), then a 10m 50% spike to see tail. Run two model configs: redwood-7b + redwood-13b-quant. We'll capture p50/p95/p99/p999, batch-size histogram, KV cache hit, and GPU util.
anya (SRE): HSM detail: customer-managed HSM in us-west1 -> extra key fetch path. I'll spin a test stub to measure median added latency. Also confirm multi-AZ failover plan.
carter (Sales Ops): For pricing, if 5 tokens/req * 900 RPS = 4500 tokens/sec baseline. I'll compute monthly reserved commit vs on-demand burst and include a sensitivity for +-30% tokens. Need the run results to finalize numbers.
marco (SE): Load generator example (use prompts harvested from prospect anonymized trace):
```
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 900 --duration 60m \
  --arrival poisson --warmup 20m --pfx-cache warm --prompts harbor_prompts.json

# spike phase
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen --qps 1350 --duration 10m --ramp 15s --arrival poisson
```
deploy-bot: staging deployment scheduled 2026-04-12T10:00Z -> artifacts at https://ci.internal/redwood/harbor/4387659999/results.tar.gz
lee (AE): Action items: Marco = runbook + heatmap + results writeup, Carter = pricing lines, Anya = HSM validation + security checklist. Marco, please include a short ops note recommending fallback routing to 7b when p99 > threshold.
marco (SE): Will do. Plan: smoke-run Tue (20m), full runs Wed/Thu. I'll attach a 1-page heatmap + raw results.json.\carter (Sales Ops): I'll draft 3 options: monthly reserved (3/12 month) and on-demand burst, plus break-even commit. Sharing draft after smoke.
anya (SRE): If HSM path adds >5ms median we recommend cached-key handles; will document tradeoffs. Also will validate that HSM certs don't block staged run.
lee (AE): Thanks team. Keep updates here. :rocket:
